caption_L1: Here a bar plot is labeled Number of toiletries , cosmetics and sundries merchant wholesalers in Canada as of December 2019 , by region. The y-axis measures Number of establishments. There is a categorical scale with Alberta on one end and Yukon at the other on the x-axis, labeled province of Canada.
caption_L2L3: The highest number of toiletries, cosmetics and sundries merchant wholesalers in Canada are located in Ontario with over 400. Quebec is has the second highest with 350, followed by British Columbia with over 150 and then Alberta having just under 100. The lowest amount of these wholesalers are located in Yukon and Prince Edward Island.
